name: Network Discovery
description: Scan your subnets for devices not in the Kea lease table. Detects rogue devices, shows discovered hostnames, and alerts on new unknowns. Requires nmap on the Jen host.
author: Matthew Thibodeau
db_migrations: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS nd_scan_jobs (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, subnet_id INT NOT NULL, started_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, finished_at DATETIME DEFAULT NULL, status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'running', hosts_found INT DEFAULT 0, rogue_count INT DEFAULT 0)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS nd_scan_results (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, job_id INT NOT NULL, ip VARCHAR(15) NOT NULL, mac VARCHAR(17), hostname VARCHAR(255), in_kea TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 0, rogue TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 0, discovered_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

name: IPAM Lite
description: Full IP address space management. See every IP in each subnet — available, dynamic, reserved, or statically noted. Add labels, owners, notes. Export to CSV. Replaces Netbox for simple static IP tracking.
author: Matthew Thibodeau
db_migrations: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ipam_static_entries (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, ip VARCHAR(15) NOT NULL UNIQUE, subnet_id INT NOT NULL, label VARCHAR(100), owner VARCHAR(100), notes TEXT, created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ipam_assignment_history (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, ip VARCHAR(15) NOT NULL, subnet_id INT NOT NULL, label VARCHAR(100), owner VARCHAR(100), action VARCHAR(20), acted_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, acted_by VARCHAR(100))
